title: Competition Adventure
welcome_lead: Every market has rivals. Who are they and what do they do? ⚔️
meta_desc: Customers & Markets Adventure 3 — KS3 Business Studies on competition, USPs and standing out.
final_note: You learned about competition, why USPs matter and how businesses respond to rivals.

concepts.def: Sells almost the same thing as you
Sells an alternative that meets the need
Your slice of total sales in a market

walkthroughs.body_html:
A competitor sells the same kind of thing you do.

  • Direct — Pepsi vs Coke.
  • Indirect — Cinema vs Netflix (both entertainment).

Both compete for your wallet. 🎬

Your USP answers: 'Why pick me?'

  • Lower price?
  • Better quality?
  • Faster service?
  • Cooler design?

Without a USP, customers just pick the cheapest.

Market share = your sales ÷ total market sales × 100.

If burger sales in town are £1,000 a day and you make £200, your share is 20%.

Growing share = winning customers from rivals. 🏆
